# Mockingbird

> Mock-endpoint platform: import an API contract (OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, protobuf/gRPC, WSDL/SOAP, AsyncAPI) and get a running mock that answers with schema-valid, LLM-generated responses, with per-session state, scenarios, chaos and event channels. One binary: `mockingbird`. Agents drive it through `mockingbird mcp` (MCP server) or JSON-printing CLI commands.

## Agents

- [Coding agents guide](docs/agents.md): install into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Kiro, VS Code, Windsurf, ChatGPT; the MCP tool list; LLM provider presets
- [Entry skill](plugins/mockingbird/skills/mockingbird/SKILL.md): what to use when
- [Setup skill](plugins/mockingbird/skills/mockingbird-setup/SKILL.md): install, LLM providers (OpenRouter, Google AI Studio, Cloudflare AI Gateway, BYOK)
- [Mock an API skill](plugins/mockingbird/skills/mockingbird-mock-api/SKILL.md): import, call, scenarios, sessions, chaos, events
- [Self-host skill](plugins/mockingbird/skills/mockingbird-deploy/SKILL.md): background server, Docker, Compose, Helm, auth, remote MCP
- [Testing skill](plugins/mockingbird/skills/mockingbird-testing/SKILL.md): offline mode, fixtures, CI
